items.description: buildCustomerReport issues one order_items query per order id in a loop (N+1) — tens of thousands of sequential queries on a hot path instead of one IN/JOIN query
The report accumulates unbounded rows into one in-memory string via += concatenation — memory and quadratic-copy risk for very large customers (streaming/chunking expected)
averageOrderValue calls reduce without an initial value and divides by length — throws TypeError on an empty array (reduce of empty array with no initial value) and NaN risk
